t: Actions are only by intentions, and every person will have only what they intended.
Sedikit-sedikit, lama-lama jadi bukit.
m: Small, steady efforts add up to great results.

t: The journey of a thousand miles begins beneath one's feet.
Take account of yourselves before you are taken to account.
s: Reported by al-Tirmidhi, Sunan, after hadith 2459

t: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
Berat sama dipikul, ringan sama dijinjing.
m: Share the burdens and the joys together.

t: Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Willing is not enough; we must do.
Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.
Knowledge is not what is memorised. Knowledge is what benefits.
Bagai resmi padi, makin berisi makin tunduk.
m: Like the rice stalk: the fuller it grows, the lower it bows. The more you know, the humbler you become.

t: The strong one is not the one who overpowers others in wrestling; the strong one is the one who controls himself when angry.
Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
O son of Adam, you are nothing but a number of days. Whenever a day passes, a part of you has gone.
Di mana ada kemahuan, di situ ada jalan.
m: Where there is a will, there is a way.

t: Allah does not look at your appearance or your wealth, but He looks at your hearts and your deeds.
Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
Make things easy and do not make them difficult. Give glad tidings and do not drive people away.
Hendak seribu daya, tak hendak seribu dalih.
m: If you truly want something you will find a thousand ways; if not, a thousand excuses.

t: Wasting time is worse than death, for wasting time cuts you off from Allah and the Hereafter, while death only cuts you off from this world and its people.
The deeds most loved by Allah are those done consistently, even if they are small.
Try not to become a man of success, but rather try to become a man of value.
Berakit-rakit ke hulu, berenang-renang ke tepian; bersakit-sakit dahulu, bersenang-senang kemudian.
m: Endure hardship first, and comfort will follow.

t: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity.
Knowledge is better than wealth: knowledge guards you, while you must guard wealth.
s: Advice to Kumayl ibn Ziyad, Hilyat al-Awliya

t: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
Whoever does not thank people has not thanked Allah.
Melentur buluh biarlah dari rebungnya.
m: Bend the bamboo while it is a shoot: shape character while young.

t: The best of you are those who are best to their families.
Darkness cannot drive out darkness; only light can do that. Hate cannot drive out hate; only love can do that.
What can my enemies do to me? My paradise and my garden are in my heart; wherever I go, they are with me.
s: Reported by Ibn al-Qayyim, al-Wabil al-Sayyib

t: Kalau tidak dipecahkan ruyung, manakan dapat sagunya.
m: Without breaking the hard bark, you will never reach the sago: no reward without effort.

t: How wonderful is the affair of the believer, for all of it is good. If good comes to him he is grateful, and if hardship befalls him he is patient, and that is good for him.
Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance, you must keep moving.
Be in this world as though you were a stranger or a traveller.
Bersatu teguh, bercerai roboh.
m: United we stand, divided we fall.

t: Knowledge cannot be attained with a body at ease.
s: Narrated by Imam Muslim in his Sahih

t: Whoever follows a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to Paradise.
Education is the passport to the future, for tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it today.
Biar lambat asalkan selamat.
m: Better slow and safe than fast and sorry.

t: A good word is charity.
I have never dealt with anything more difficult than my own intention, for it keeps turning on me.
Well done is better than well said.
Allah is Gentle and loves gentleness in all matters.
Alang-alang menyeluk pekasam, biar sampai ke pangkal lengan.
m: If you are going to do something, do it fully.

t: Richness is not in having many possessions; true richness is the richness of the soul.
Kalau hidup sekadar hidup, babi di hutan juga hidup. Kalau bekerja sekadar bekerja, kera juga bekerja.
m: If life is only living, the wild boar lives too; if work is only working, the ape works too.

t: If I have seen further, it is by standing on the shoulders of giants.
Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt.
Sesal dahulu pendapatan, sesal kemudian tiada gunanya.
m: Think before you act; regret afterwards is of no use.

t: Part of the excellence of a person's Islam is leaving what does not concern him.
The unexamined life is not worth living.
Patience is holding the soul back from despair, the tongue from complaining, and the limbs from wrongdoing.
Do not belittle any good deed, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.
Ukur baju di badan sendiri.
m: Measure the shirt against your own body: live within your means and know your limits.

t: While we are postponing, life speeds by.
The upper hand is better than the lower hand.
s: Sahih al-Bukhari 1429, Sahih Muslim 1033 (the giving hand is better than the receiving hand)

t: Malu bertanya sesat jalan.
m: Too shy to ask, and you lose your way.

t: With the inkpot, until the graveyard.
s: On seeking knowledge for a whole lifetime, Ibn al-Jawzi, Manaqib al-Imam Ahmad

t: Fear Allah wherever you are; follow a bad deed with a good one and it will wipe it out; and treat people with good character.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
s: Summarising Aristotle, The Story of Philosophy, 1926

t: Bagai aur dengan tebing.
m: Like bamboo and the riverbank: each holds the other up.

t: The most complete of the believers in faith are those with the best character.
I have never regretted anything as I regret a day whose sun set, my life grew shorter, and my deeds did not increase.
s: Attributed, reported in works on zuhd

t: Imagination is more important than knowledge.
Whoever relieves a believer of a hardship of this world, Allah will relieve him of a hardship on the Day of Resurrection.
Belakang parang pun jika diasah, lagikan tajam.
m: Even the back of a machete becomes sharp if it is honed: effort can sharpen anyone.

t: The religion is sincerity.
The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
Bulat air kerana pembetung, bulat manusia kerana muafakat.
m: Water is shaped by the pipe, people are united by agreement.

t: Be mindful of Allah, and He will protect you. Be mindful of Allah, and you will find Him before you.
The believer is the mirror of his brother.
Tak kenal maka tak cinta.
m: You cannot love what you do not know.

t: Know that victory comes with patience, relief comes with hardship, and with difficulty comes ease.
The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.
Yang dikejar tak dapat, yang dikendong berciciran.
m: Chasing what you cannot catch, you drop what you already hold.

t: The best of people are those most beneficial to people.
s: Al-Mu'jam al-Awsat of al-Tabarani, graded hasan

t: Bumi mana yang tidak ditimpa hujan.
m: What land is never touched by rain: everyone faces trials and makes mistakes.

t: Stay hungry. Stay foolish.
s: Stanford commencement address, 2005, quoting the Whole Earth Catalog

t: Take advantage of five before five: your youth before old age, your health before sickness, your wealth before poverty, your free time before busyness, and your life before death.
Jauhari juga yang mengenal manikam.
m: Only a jeweller knows a true gem: real worth is recognised by those who understand it.

t: Purity is half of faith.
Genggam bara api biar sampai jadi arang.
m: Hold the burning ember until it turns to charcoal: persevere until the task is done.

t: He is not a believer who eats his fill while his neighbour beside him goes hungry.
